verdict.rationale: Puzzle has an API, marketed for Embedded Accounting. Its help article says the API 'was originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations', which suggests it is partner-oriented rather than a self-serve public API for individual users. Probes found no public OpenAPI or Swagger spec, though an official MCP integration with Claude gives an AI-driven access path. Missing for 10: publicly accessible API reference/spec, documented self-serve auth and endpoints for end users, evidence of write/automation coverage via API, independent hands-on corroboration.
